# spainpolls

`spainpolls` is an R client for the Spain Electoral Polls API. It
returns tidy `tibble`s for elections, pollsters, parties, polls,
long-format poll results, and voting-intention time series.

The package queries the public read-only API documented in
`docs/r-package-handoff/`. It does not access PostgreSQL directly,
scrape data, or modify records.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("hmeleiro/spainpolls")
```

## Covered Endpoints

The package covers these public endpoints:

- `GET /health`
- `GET /api/v1/elections`
- `GET /api/v1/pollsters`
- `GET /api/v1/parties`
- `GET /api/v1/polls`
- `GET /api/v1/polls/{poll_id}`
- `GET /api/v1/results`
- `GET /api/v1/timeseries`

`GET /api/v1/polls/{poll_id}/results` is not implemented by the API. Use
[`get_poll_results()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_poll_results.md)
to fetch `/api/v1/polls/{poll_id}` and extract the nested results.

## Basic Use

``` r

library(spainpolls)

elections <- get_elections(limit = 10)
pollsters <- get_pollsters(election_key = "congreso_espana_2026")
parties <- get_parties(election_key = "congreso_espana_2026")

elections
```

## Polls

``` r

polls <- get_polls(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  limit = 10
)

poll <- get_poll(101)
poll_results <- get_poll_results(101)

poll
#> # A tibble: 1 × 19
#>      id election_key     election_name territory_code pollster_key pollster_name
```

## Long Results

``` r

results <- get_results(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  party = "psoe",
  collect_all = TRUE
)
```

## Time Series

``` r

ts <- get_timeseries(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  party = c("psoe", "pp", "vox", "sumar", "podemos"),  
  date_from = "2025-01-01", date_to = "2026-11-11", 
  collect_all = TRUE
)

ts
#> # A tibble: 1,824 × 15
#>    date       poll_id pollster_key  pollster_name media    sample_size party_key
#>    <date>       <int> <chr>         <chr>         <chr>          <int> <chr>
```

## Plotting

``` r

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(ts, aes(x= date, y = vote_share, color = color_hex)) +
geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_point(alpha = .3) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 1, se = FALSE, span = .7) +
  labs(
    title = "Voting intention for main parties",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Vote share (%)"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme_minimal()
#> `geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'
#> Warning: Removed 14 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
#> (`stat_smooth()`).
#> Warning: Removed 14 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
#> (`geom_point()`).
```

## Pagination

Paginated functions accept `limit`, `offset`, and `collect_all`.

``` r

all_results <- get_results(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  collect_all = TRUE
)

all_results
#> # A tibble: 8,798 × 18
#>    party_key  party_raw party_name short_name color_hex display_order vote_share
#>    <chr>      <chr>     <chr>      <chr>      <chr>             <int>      <dbl>
#>  1 psoe       PSOE      Partido S… PSOE       #e30613              10       31.2
#>  2 pp         PP        Partido P… PP         #1d84ce              20       28.5
#>  3 vox        Vox       Vox        Vox        #63be21              30       17.5
#>  4 fa_fv      FA + FV   Frente Am… FA–FV      <NA>                 35        7.5
#>  5 erc        ERC       Esquerra … ERC        #f3b217              70        2.6
#>  6 salf       SALF      Se Acabo … SALF       #5d6470             200        2  
#>  7 podemos    Podemos   Podemos    Podemos    #6f2c91              50        1.7
#>  8 adelante_… Adelante… Adelante … AA         #00a3ad             190        1.4
#>  9 eh_bildu   EH Bildu  EH Bildu   EH Bildu   #b5c800              90        1.4
#> 10 junts      Junts     Junts per… Junts      #00a6a6              80        1.3
#> # ℹ 8,788 more rows
#> # ℹ 11 more variables: seats_min <int>, seats_max <int>, poll_id <int>,
#> #   date <date>, election_key <chr>, pollster_key <chr>, pollster_name <chr>,
#> #   media <chr>, fieldwork_end <date>, publication_date <date>,
#> #   sample_size <int>
```

When `collect_all = TRUE`, the client starts at offset 0 and requests
pages until the API reports that all matching rows have been downloaded.

## Errors

The package validates common bad inputs before making HTTP requests,
including invalid `limit`, `offset`, dates, logical flags, `poll_id`,
and `date_field`. HTTP errors from the API are rethrown as clear R
errors with `cli`.

## Spain Electoral Project

This package is part of the Spain Electoral Project ecosystem. Cite or
link the Spain Electoral Project when using the API data in public work.

## Current Limitations

- The API is read-only and unauthenticated in v1.
- Administrative endpoints are not included.
- [`get_poll_results()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_poll_results.md)
  extracts nested results because the API does not expose a separate
  poll-results route.
- Sorting order is determined by the API and is not specified as a
  stable client contract.

# Package index

## Configuration

Configure the API endpoint and check service availability.

- [`spainpolls_api_url()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/spainpolls_api_url.md)
  : Get the Spain Electoral Polls API URL
- [`set_spainpolls_api_url()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/set_spainpolls_api_url.md)
  : Configure the Spain Electoral Polls API URL
- [`spainpolls_health()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/spainpolls_health.md)
  : Check API health

## Elections and catalogues

Discover elections, pollsters, and parties available through the API.

- [`get_elections()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_elections.md)
  : Get elections
- [`get_pollsters()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_pollsters.md)
  : Get pollsters
- [`get_parties()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_parties.md)
  : Get parties

## Polls and results

Download poll metadata, party results, and voting-intention time series.

- [`get_polls()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_polls.md)
  : Get polls
- [`get_poll()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_poll.md)
  : Get one poll
- [`get_poll_results()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_poll_results.md)
  : Get results for one poll
- [`get_results()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_results.md)
  : Get poll results
- [`get_timeseries()`](https://spainelectoralproject.github.io/spainpolls/reference/get_timeseries.md)
  : Get poll time series
